tags.name: Organization
tags.description:
Identity and capacity for the organization tied to your API key.
Start with GET organization (sanity check), then GET organization/usage before bulk imports or CI loops.

tags.name: Domain Groups
tags.description:
First infrastructure layer: groups scope domains, subdomains, rules, tests, and link maps.
Set robots policy defaults here before attaching domains.

tags.name: Domains
tags.description:
Your custom hostnames assigned to a domain group.
Create after the group exists; rules match traffic on these hosts.

tags.name: Subdomains
tags.description:
LinkShift-hosted short labels (e.g. `promo` → `promo.linkshift.app`) in a domain group.
Use when you don't bring your own domain yet.

tags.name: Redirect Rules
tags.description:
Matching logic and HTTP status for live redirects.
Pair with POST simulate (no live traffic) and GET analytics (aggregated hits).
List/create require `domainGroupId`.

tags.name: Redirect Tests
tags.description:
Named fixtures (path + expected outcome) for regression and CI.
Store expectations here; run POST redirect-rules/simulate to evaluate them in pipelines.

tags.name: Link Maps
tags.description:
Named key→URL tables referenced by rules via `linkMapId`.
Create the map, then add entries (or import) before pointing a rule at it.

tags.name: Link Map Entries
tags.description: Keys inside a link map. Supports cursor list, single CRUD, bulk delete (rollback), and import (up to 500 rows, create-only).
